subject: design/argus-attribution-hardening
statement: The `Argus-Drive: <slug>` authorship trailer is **produced by the commit-authoring actor** (the supervisor/harness) at the moment it authors a drive's commit, realized as a **repo-internal git commit-message hook** (`prepare-commit-msg`/`commit-msg`-class) on the existing `core.hooksPath` surface; it is keyed on the active drive's slug (the context the supervisor already holds) — never chosen by the model, never hand-added *(design-brainstorm:argus-attribution-hardening-tech-design#D-1)*.
